author: Jason Stys
summary: Assign and unassign tenant agents with shared version checks, atomic audit/outbox writes and bounded ticket history; filter owner/SLA queues and recheck stale authorization and SLA candidates.
rationale: Turns a ticket list into an auditable support workflow that resists lost updates, partial commits and cross-tenant mistakes.
limitations: Synthetic local demo; the identity adapter is not production authentication and notifications use a log adapter.
Bounded offset history can shift under concurrent inserts; it is not a signed snapshot or enterprise scaling claim.
Browser checks cover desktop/mobile Chromium-family and no-JavaScript paths, not every device or assistive technology.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
